derivation: adverb from a derivative of G3071 (Λυκαονία);
def: Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians

occurrences.text: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
